entries.title: Proverbs 31:1
segments: ¶The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:2
segments: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? and what, O son of my vows?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:3
segments: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to them that destroy kings.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:4
segments: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for rulers [to say], Where is the strong drink?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:5
segments: --lest they drink and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the children of affliction.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:6
segments: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto the bitter of soul:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:7
segments: let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:8
segments: Open thy mouth for the dumb, for the cause of all those that are left desolate.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:9
segments: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and minister justice to the afflicted and needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:10
segments: ¶Who can find a woman of worth? for her price is far above rubies.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:11
segments: The heart of her husband confideth in her, and he shall have no lack of spoil.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:12
segments: She doeth him good, and not evil, all the days of her life.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:13
segments: She seeketh wool and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:14
segments: She is like the merchants' ships: she bringeth her food from afar;

entries.title: Proverbs 31:15
segments: And she riseth while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and the day's work to her maidens.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:16
segments: She considereth a field, and acquireth it; of the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:17
segments: She girdeth her loins with strength, and maketh strong her arms.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:18
segments: She perceiveth that her earning is good; her lamp goeth not out by night.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:19
segments: She putteth her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:20
segments: She stretcheth out her hand to the afflicted, and she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:21
segments: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:22
segments: She maketh herself coverlets; her clothing is byssus and purple.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:23
segments: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:24
segments: She maketh body linen and selleth it, and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:25
segments: Strength and dignity are her clothing, and she laugheth [at] the coming day.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:26
segments: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and upon her tongue is the law of kindness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:27
segments: She surveyeth the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:28
segments: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband [also], and he praiseth her:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:29
segments: Many daughters have done worthily, but thou excellest them all.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:30
segments: Gracefulness is deceitful and beauty is vain; a woman [that] feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:31
segments: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her own works praise her in the gates.
